label: Connectives linking person names
explanation: The feature fires on the "joints" of person pairs and lists — "and", "&", commas, hyphens, colons, quotes, parentheses that link or introduce names ("Alex and Jamie", "Tim & Mario", "Alex, Jamie, and Taylor", Martin "Marty" Krugman) — strongest for explicit name pairs/groups, often near words like "friends", and even for dialect "an'". It fires more weakly and variably on other tokens adjacent to person references ("with people", "love him", "know Doon") and on non-name enumerations (brands, credits). It stays silent on the vast majority of "and"/"," occurrences (ordinary clause-joining uses) and shows no positional pattern.
